name: exploded-aeropress-claude-haiku-5.5-s1-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an AeroPress coffee maker, as an SVG. Use the original model with a round paper filter rather than the Go or the XL.

grade.detail: passed what it measured; left to the eye: labels

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 1000" width="800" height="1000" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="clear" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#dfeef5"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#cfe3ee"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="plastic" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#b8bcc2"/>
      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#eef0f2"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#9ea4ab"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rubber" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2b2b2b"/>
      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#555"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1e1e1e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="paper" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c9b48a"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#f3e6c4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c2aa7c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cap" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4f6f8c"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#8fb1cc"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#3f5d78"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="10" height="10" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="5" cy="5" r="2" fill="#5d6770"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <text x="400" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#222">AeroPress — Exploded Assembly</text>
  <text x="400" y="56" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#666">Original model with round paper filter</text>

  <!-- alignment axis -->
  <line x1="400" y1="75" x2="400" y2="935" stroke="#bbb" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="6,5"/>

  <!-- 1. PLUNGER -->
  <rect x="322" y="92" width="156" height="34" rx="16" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="386" y="126" width="28" height="206" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- 2. RUBBER SEAL -->
  <rect x="346" y="332" width="108" height="30" rx="6" fill="url(#rubber)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="342" x2="454" y2="342" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="346" y1="352" x2="454" y2="352" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 3. CHAMBER -->
  <rect x="344" y="446" width="112" height="250" fill="url(#clear)" stroke="#4a6b7d" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="330" y="430" width="140" height="18" rx="6" fill="url(#clear)" stroke="#4a6b7d" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="334" y="694" width="132" height="14" rx="4" fill="#dfeef5" stroke="#4a6b7d" stroke-width="2"/>
  <g stroke="#4a6b7d" stroke-width="1">
    <line x1="344" y1="500" x2="362" y2="500"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="550" x2="356" y2="550"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="600" x2="362" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="650" x2="356" y2="650"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 4. PAPER FILTER -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="770" rx="60" ry="9" fill="url(#paper)" stroke="#8a7650" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="767" rx="60" ry="9" fill="#f7eed8" stroke="#8a7650" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 5. FILTER CAP -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="906" rx="62" ry="10" fill="url(#mesh)" stroke="#44515c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="340" y="812" width="120" height="88" fill="url(#cap)" stroke="#2c4157" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g stroke="#2c4157" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6">
    <line x1="356" y1="818" x2="356" y2="894"/>
    <line x1="372" y1="818" x2="372" y2="894"/>
    <line x1="388" y1="818" x2="388" y2="894"/>
    <line x1="404" y1="818" x2="404" y2="894"/>
    <line x1="420" y1="818" x2="420" y2="894"/>
    <line x1="436" y1="818" x2="436" y2="894"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="332" y="802" width="136" height="14" rx="5" fill="url(#cap)" stroke="#2c4157" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- LABEL LEADERS (right side only) -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1">
    <line x1="480" y1="109" x2="590" y2="109"/>
    <line x1="456" y1="350" x2="590" y2="350"/>
    <line x1="456" y1="500" x2="590" y2="500"/>
    <line x1="462" y1="767" x2="590" y2="767"/>
    <line x1="462" y1="860" x2="590" y2="860"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="15" fill="#222">
    <text x="596" y="105">1  Plunger</text>
    <text x="596" y="346">2  Rubber seal</text>
    <text x="596" y="496">3  Chamber</text>
    <text x="596" y="763">4  Paper filter (round)</text>
    <text x="596" y="856">5  Filter cap</text>
  </g>

  <text x="400" y="955" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#666">Parts shown exploded along the assembly axis.</text>
  <text x="400" y="973" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#666">Assembly: place paper filter in filter cap, screw cap onto chamber base, then insert plunger (seal on) from the top.</text>
</svg>
